semantics.source_product_total: 1698 is EFHub packs catalogue reported total, including historical/reward/campaign entries; not current sale count or draw-pool size.
semantics.source_card_total: 50840 is the earlier EFHub card catalogue reported total, not actual persons and not validated unique acquired cards.
semantics.source_listed_player_count: Count of cards displayed for the EFHub product page/grid; collection checks this count but does not prove full game composition.
semantics.official_initial_player_count: Initial draw pool count explicitly reported by official probability page, not a user remaining pool; only applies to that identified official list.
semantics.unverified_missing_values: null means unknown, not zero. Empty missing IDs are used only for the source displayed grid whose IDs are enumerated.
semantics.source_date: API date and HTML date are source display metadata; sale periods require product-specific official evidence.

parser_review.boundary_policy: Only direct PlayerCard children in exact product title/count sibling grid, compared to direct DOM player links; recommendations remain outside the roster boundary.

code_evidence.purpose: Exact title/count/grid direct children, explicit lazy record resolution; no playerType selection.
Validate all IDs/types, require declared count and DOM ID agreement, return the whole grid.
Normalize every raw card; known type1 is accepted by the same mapping as all other supported types.
Includes normal label and maps every bootstrap player; no type-based exclusion.
Hash full bytes, retain observation metadata; no complete response body file written.
Preserve complete extracted players_payload and bounded first-card excerpt.

parser_review.conclusion: No evidence of collector-side Standard/normal omission. The saved verified grid has no raw type1. Whether Standard cards exist outside that grid or in a full in-game pool remains unknown.

acceptance_criteria: 공식 상품명·회차·지역/플랫폼·판매기간·공급자 상품ID와 초기/잔여 범위를 연결한다.
공식 초기 수와 공급자 전체 페이지/최종응답·총계 안정성을 대조한다.
출시 카드 원본 문자열 ID·상품 포함 관계·수량·분류·관찰시각과 버전의 근거를 보존한다.
고유ID 수·수량 합계·중복/누락을 별도로 확인하고 임의 Standard/이름/숫자규칙으로 채우지 않는다.
Magical150 목표는 공식 동일회차 연결과 실제150 전체ID 실증 전 성공으로 선언하지 않는다.
이미지URL/이름/표시값 전체 검사와 실제 이미지 응답의 표본/전수 검사를 구분한다.
실패/빈응답/구성감소는 정상 누적 관계와 공개 데이터를 자동 삭제하지 않는다.
선수 초기 풀의 완료는 감독/다른구성까지 포함한 상품 전체 완료·R6실제운영 완료가 아니다.
